mapper.select: SELECT HI.HOUSE_IMG_SN, HI.HOUSE_SN, HI.ATCH_FILE_SN, HI.SORT_SEQ, HI.RPRS_YN, A.URL_ADDR, A.ORGNL_FILE_NM FROM HOUSE_IMAGE HI JOIN ATCH_FILE A ON A.ATCH_FILE_SN = HI.ATCH_FILE_SN WHERE HI.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND HI.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY HI.SORT_SEQ, HI.HOUSE_IMG_SN
SELECT HOUSE_IMG_SN, HOUSE_SN, ATCH_FILE_SN, SORT_SEQ, RPRS_YN, DEL_YN FROM HOUSE_IMAGE WHERE HOUSE_IMG_SN = #{houseImgSn} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SORT_SEQ), 0) FROM HOUSE_IMAGE WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSE_IMAGE WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSE_IMAGE WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND RPRS_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT HOUSE_IMG_SN FROM HOUSE_IMAGE WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ, HOUSE_IMG_SN LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE HOUSE_IMAGE SET RPRS_YN = 'N', MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND RPRS_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT ATCH_FILE_SN FROM HOUSE_IMAGE WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE HOUSE_IMAGE SET DEL_YN = 'Y', RPRS_YN = 'N', MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
